name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty, streaming, and exploration accelerator company focused on precious metals properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds mineral interests including the Lazy Claims, Loman, Agai-Pah, and Swales properties in Nevada plus the Belshazzar property in Idaho, all at the exploration stage. Nevada Canyon operates with a low-overhead royalty and streaming business model rather than as a conventional mining operator.
